==The Skinsack Shed==
[[File:1618.png|thumb|375px]]Connects to: 16.16.04, 16.16.07, 23.16 and 29.14.37.

There is a shed here around a mile from the road. Bags made of skin hang from iron hooks set into the roof of the shed (to create the [[sack children]] of [[Baron Autumn]]).
===Hooks:===
*Who owns and uses the shed?
